Blind World Hub is now online: accessible apps, guides and videos for blind and visually impaired people, in one place.
Blind World Hub is run by Waqas, a blind YouTube creator who shares accessible apps, guides and video reviews for blind and visually impaired people.
Blind World Hub is built for screen reader users and aims to meet WCAG 2.2 level AA.
Contact Blind World Hub through its WhatsApp community or YouTube channel to ask a question, suggest an app or report a problem.
Apps on Blind World Hub are shared as they are. Owners who want an app removed can contact us.
Blind World Hub does not collect personal data. It has no accounts, no tracking and no advertising.
